movie.title: Air Bud Returns
movie.overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Grieving the loss of his father, 12-year-old Jacob moves to Fernfield, where a forgotten VHS tape and a bond with a neglected, basketball-playing golden retriever help him heal and rediscover his passion for the game.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After losing his father, 12-year-old Jacob relocates with his mother to his late dad’s childhood home in Fernfield. While exploring, Jacob finds a VHS tape showing his father playing basketball alongside a legendary hoop-shooting golden retriever. Inspired by this discovery, Jacob forms a bond with a local, neglected golden retriever he names Buddy. Together, they embark on a heart-wrenching and inspiring journey on and off the court.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Twelve-year-old Jacob is struggling to cope with the sudden loss of his father, an avid basketball fan who deeply inspired his young son. Seeking a fresh start, Jacob and his mother move into his dad's childhood home located in the small town of Fernfield. While sorting through his late father's old possessions, Jacob uncovers a forgotten VHS tape depicting his dad playing basketball alongside a miraculous golden retriever. Struck by this magical piece of family history, Jacob begins visiting the same community court depicted in the footage. There, he encounters a neglected local golden retriever who displays an uncanny affinity for basketball. Jacob takes the dog in, naming him Buddy in honor of the original legend, and the pair quickly develop an inseparable connection. As Jacob practices for the local basketball team, Buddy becomes his ultimate teammate and emotional anchor. Together, they navigate the ups and downs of competitive play while helping Jacob's family honor his father's legacy.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Air Bud Returns follows 12-year-old Jacob, an aspiring basketball player grappling with deep grief after the passing of his father. Moving to his dad's hometown of Fernfield, Jacob feels disconnected until a hidden VHS tape unveils a magical chapter of his father's past—playing basketball alongside a golden retriever. Driven by curiosity and a desire to connect with his dad's memory, Jacob stumbles upon a lonely, neglected golden retriever in town. Naming the dog Buddy, Jacob discovers the canine possesses extraordinary athletic talent. As Jacob attempts to find his footing on the court and adapt to his new life, his blossoming friendship with Buddy helps him process his grief, rebuild his confidence, and embrace the power of family, sportsmanship, and healing.

story_structure.climax: During a crucial, high-stakes game, Jacob and his team face a formidable opponent while unexpected obstacles threaten to prevent Buddy from helping them when they need it most.
story_structure.conflict: Struggling to cope with his grief and fit into a new town, Jacob finds a neglected golden retriever named Buddy and forms a bond, while facing local challenges and personal doubts about his basketball abilities.
story_structure.resolution: Jacob embraces his father's legacy, discovers his own strength both on and off the court, and secures a loving, permanent home for Buddy.
story_structure.introduction: 12-year-old Jacob and his mother move to his late father's childhood home in Fernfield, where Jacob discovers an old VHS tape featuring his father playing basketball alongside a talented golden retriever.
story_structure.risingAction: Jacob and Buddy start practicing together, leading to Jacob gaining confidence and earning a spot on the local basketball team as Buddy becomes a beloved community mascot and secret teammate.
